blocks.text: DAVAO CITY – Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon inspected Monday morning the nearly completed P100 million flood control project in San Juan Village, Barangay Bangkal here. He told reporters the flood mitigation project is 80 percent complete after two months of work. Last July 24, the Talomo River overflowed due to heavy rains, causing severe flash floods that affected thousands of families in low-lying areas. READ: 1 dead, 1,200 displaced as floods hit Davao City Dizon said the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) projected that the three-meter-high, 109-meter-long gabion wall will be finished in December.
